services.title: Engine Repair
services.short: Diagnostics, tune-ups, timing belts and full engine rebuilds.
services.description: From misfires to complete overhauls, our engine specialists restore performance and fuel efficiency using factory-grade diagnostic equipment.
services.imageAlt: Mechanic repairing a car engine in a garage setting

services.title: Brake Repair
services.short: Pads, discs, callipers and full brake system servicing.
services.description: Your safety depends on your brakes. We inspect, repair and replace every component to manufacturer specifications with same-day service on most vehicles.
services.imageAlt: Mechanic in blue uniform performing brake repair on a car

services.title: Oil & Filter Service
services.short: Full oil, filter and fluid top-up with every visit.
services.description: Regular oil changes are the cheapest insurance for your engine. Our 30-minute service keeps your warranty intact and your engine protected.
services.imageAlt: Mechanic inspecting and filling engine oil in a car at a service centre

services.title: Car AC Service
services.short: Recharging, leak detection and full climate control repair.
services.description: Stay cool all year. We recharge refrigerant, repair leaks and service compressors so your cabin reaches the right temperature fast.
services.imageAlt: Mechanic conducting a vehicle inspection in an automotive garage

services.title: Battery & Electrical
services.short: Testing, replacement and full charging system diagnostics.
services.description: A dead battery ruins your day. We test your battery, alternator and starter, then fit a guaranteed replacement if needed — usually within the hour.
services.imageAlt: Mechanic inspecting car engine bay and battery during routine maintenance

services.title: Tyre & Wheel Service
services.short: Fitting, balancing, alignment and puncture repair.
services.description: Maximise tyre life and fuel economy. We fit, balance and align your wheels with precision equipment and repair punctures whenever safe.
services.imageAlt: Mechanic in blue coveralls replacing a tyre on a vehicle in a repair shop

services.title: Computer Diagnostics
services.short: Advanced OBD-II scanning and fault code analysis.
services.description: A warning light shouldn't be a mystery. Our diagnostic scanners read every module in your vehicle and pinpoint the exact issue — no guesswork.
services.imageAlt: Mechanic using a diagnostic tool inside a car to check for engine issues

services.title: Transmission Service
services.short: Gearbox repair, fluid flush and clutch replacement.
services.description: Smooth shifts and reliable power delivery. We service automatic and manual transmissions, including clutch replacement and full gearbox rebuilds.
services.imageAlt: Mechanic using tools to repair a car transmission in an indoor workshop

faqs.question: Do I need an appointment, or can I just drive in?
faqs.answer: We strongly recommend booking ahead so we can allocate a bay and a technician for you. Same-day appointments are often available — call us or use the online booking form and we'll fit you in as soon as we can.

faqs.question: Do you work on all makes and models?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our technicians are trained across European, Japanese, Korean and domestic vehicles, from city cars to light commercial vans. If you have something unusual, give us a call and we'll confirm.

faqs.question: Is your work guaranteed?
faqs.answer: Every repair we carry out comes with a 12-month / 12,000-mile workmanship guarantee, whichever comes first. Parts carry their own manufacturer warranty on top of that.

faqs.question: Can you provide a written estimate before starting work?
faqs.answer: Always. We inspect your vehicle first, then provide a written, itemised estimate. We never start work or order parts without your explicit approval, so there are no surprise charges.

faqs.question: Do you offer a courtesy car or a lift while my car is in?
faqs.answer: We have a comfortable waiting area with complimentary coffee and Wi-Fi. We can also arrange a local courtesy car or a shuttle within a 5-mile radius — just ask when booking.

faqs.question: How often should I get my oil changed?
faqs.answer: For most modern vehicles every 5,000–7,500 miles or every 6 months, whichever comes first. If you do a lot of short trips or city driving, stick to the shorter interval. We'll send you a reminder when the next one is due.
